description: This is an HTML file implementing the user interface for a database visualizer web application. It includes layout, styles, and client-side scripts to browse databases, tables, and view data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and displaying loading indicators.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables and loads tables on demand.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table, with a limit of 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates and inserts an HTML table from the data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on value type, supporting object expansion and long string truncation.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncate view.
